raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-18 the payments source sends reversals as separate REVERSAL rows and leaves the original POSTED. The silver filter keeps every POSTED original and drops the REVERSAL rows, so reversed amounts are never netted out and gold totals run high for recent days. Excluding POSTED originals that a REVERSAL row points to via orig_txn_id restores the netting, assuming a reversal fully cancels its original.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND txn_id NOT IN (SELECT orig_txn_id FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL);"}}
